TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Atta ta ni-pa-sousou-en ti Jesus, ka ni-pa-passou-va-vau-en tyn pa-passouvavullum ta matta tyn, k'ma, Rama ierrou'-ato ta kidi ki tæ'lei, pouvavau-au ki kidi ta Alak oho', alei ka pou-vavau-âl-appa ki kidi ta Alak oho ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
耶穌說了這話，就舉目望天，說：「父啊，時候到了，願你榮耀你的兒子，使兒子也榮耀你；

S.FORM: Mama ki ni-phæ-en-hou tyni-æn taligh tou ymmud ki vaät, alei ka kamamang ka ni-phæ-en-hou tyni-æn, phæ̈-eih tyn neini-æn ta kæuag-han ka myh-ka-koua myddarynnough.
S.TRANSL: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
正如你曾賜給他權柄管理凡有血氣的，叫他將永生賜給你所賜給他的人。

S.FORM: Att'appa ta kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myddarynnough, ka kmalang-ah ta neni ymhou-an dyk saäsat ki Alid ka d'lligh, ti Je-sus-an-appa ka ti Christus ka ni-padingi-en-hou.
S.TRANSL: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
認識你－獨一的真神，並且認識你所差來的耶穌基督，這就是永生。

S.FORM: Ni-pou-vavau-en-nau-kow ki kidi tou næi: ni-malymmoulymmou-koh ki poungas ka ni-phæ-en-nau paka-poungas jau-an.
S.TRANSL: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
我在地上已經榮耀你，你所託付我的事，我已成全了。

S.FORM: Ra hnyn pou-vavau-a ki kidi jau-an ymhou Rama ki kidi ka akoume'-en-nau ymhou-an, rou ä'ou-ssi appa ta næi.
S.TRANSL: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
父啊，現在求你使我同你享榮耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的榮耀。

S.FORM: Ni-pou-pænæh-koh ki Na-nang-hou tou kæ'uloung-an ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an tou næi. A-mhou ta neni, ka ni-phæ-en-hou ta neni jau-an, ka ni-hma ta neni ki sou-oho.
S.TRANSL: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
「你從世上賜給我的人，我已將你的名顯明與他們。他們本是你的，你將他們賜給我，他們也遵守了你的道。

S.FORM: Hnyn kmalang-ato ta neni ka mamang, ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an, ka na â-mhou ta anna.
S.TRANSL: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
如今他們知道，凡你所賜給我的，都是從你那裏來的；

S.FORM: Ka sou k'anna ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an, na pæp'æ̈-au nei-ni-æn, ka ni-atta-ryh-en nein ta anna, ka d'lligh-âto kmalang ka ni-tæ'i-koua-en-nau makka-rbo ymhou-an, ka tna-'msing-ato ta neni ka ni-padingi-en-hou jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
因為你所賜給我的道，我已經賜給他們，他們也領受了，又確實知道，我是從你出來的，並且信你差了我來。

S.FORM: Tmoumymmya-koh alei neini-æn: Assi-koh tmoumym-mia alei ki næi, râ alei-appa neini-æn ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an, alei ka â-'mhou ta neni.
S.TRANSL: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
我為他們祈求，不為世人祈求，卻為你所賜給我的人祈求，因他們本是你的。

S.FORM: Ka ymmud ki â-jau, â-'mhou-appa, ka â-mhou a-jau-ap-pa: ka ni-pou-vavau-en-koh ki ki-di neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，並且我因他們得了榮耀。

S.FORM: Ka äouloug-koh hnyn tou næi, râ 'æ̈-i-a-næi-appa ta ne-ni k'atta, ka mou-koua-ah-koh ymhou-an. Rama ka d'lligh ma-tiktik, k'ading-au ta neni tou Nanang-ohou, ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an, alei ka sasat-ah ta neni mama ymytt-æn.
S.TRANSL: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
從今以後，我不在世上，他們卻在世上；我往你那裏去。聖父啊，求你因你所賜給我的名保守他們，叫他們合而為一像我們一樣。

S.FORM: Dou æ-'i-a-lam-app'-oh neini-æn tou næi, ni-kading-au ta neni tou Nanang-ohou. Neni ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an ni-ka-ding-en-nau, ka assi ni-tau-rumma ta ti mamang neini-æn, dyk ki Alak ki s-dad-'an, alei ka paveut-auh ta na Sa-soulat.
S.TRANSL: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衛了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。

S.FORM: Ra hnyn mou-koua-koh ymhou-an, ka pa-sousou-en-nau ta atta tou næi, alei ka paka-tmoei-auh neini-æn ta karai-en-nau.
S.TRANSL: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
現在我往你那裏去，我還在世上說這話，是叫他們心裏充滿我的喜樂。

S.FORM: Ni-phæ-en-nau neini-æn ta sou-oho, ka næi ta ni-mavahier neini-æn, alei ka assi makka næi ta neni, mama ka assi-koh makka næi ti jau.
S.TRANSL: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
我已將你的道賜給他們。世界又恨他們；因為他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。

S.FORM: Assi-koh tmou-mymmia ki æ̈'æumi-'ei-'mhou ta neni tou næi, râ k'ading-aul-appa-'mhou ta neni ki Tama-pakat'ee.
S.TRANSL: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
我不求你叫他們離開世界，只求你保守他們脫離那惡者。

S.FORM: Assi makka næi ta neni mama jau-an ka assi-koh makka næi.
S.TRANSL: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。

S.FORM: Paka-d'lligh-au paka-tiktik ta neni tou katiktik-kan ki sou-oho: nda sou-oho ta katik-tik-kan ki sou.
S.TRANSL: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。

S.FORM: Mama ki ni-padadingi-en-hou jau-an pa-'ou-koua tou næi, ni-padingi-au komma-hyn-na pa-'ou-koua ta neni tou næi.
S.TRANSL: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。

S.FORM: Ka paka-mado-en-nau paka-d'lligh paka-tiktik jau-an alei neini-æn, ki paka-d'lligh-eil-appa ta neni pakatiktik tou ka-tiktik-kan ki sou.
S.TRANSL: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。

S.FORM: Assi-koh tmou-dyk tmou-mymmia alei neini-æn k'atta, ra alei appa neini-æn ka tna-'msing-ah jau-an ki na sou nein.
S.TRANSL: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
「我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，

S.FORM: Alei ka mako-i-ä ym'd-dâh mako'i sat ta neni, mama ymhou Rama jau-an, ti jau-appa ymhou-an, ka mako-i-saat-al-ap-pa ta neni ymytt'-æn: alei ka tna-'msing ah ta næi ki ni-padingi-en-hou jau-an.
S.TRANSL: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裏面，我在你裏面，使他們也在我們裏面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。

S.FORM: Ka ni-phæ-en-nau neini-æn ta keirang-an ki kidi ka na pæp'æ-oho jau-an: alei ka saäsat-ah ta neni mama ka saäsat-kytta ta ymyt-ta.
S.TRANSL: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。

S.FORM: Ti jau neini-æn, imhou-appa jau-an: alei ka makoi ta-raæug-â 'ta neni makoi-sat, ka kmalang-al-appa ta næi, ki ni-pa-dingi-en hou jau-an, ka ni-kavæ-'angö-en appa'-'mhou neini-æn: mama ki ni-kavæ'angö-en-hou jau-an.
S.TRANSL: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
我在他們裏面，你在我裏面，使他們完完全全地合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。

S.FORM: Rama, mamoei-koh tou æ-i-a-koua ei-mau, i-tou-lam-ap-pa jau-an ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an: alei ka mararau-ah ta neni ki keirang-en ki kidi-au, ka ni-phæ-en hou jau-an, nda ni-mavæ'angö kow jau-an, rou assi-appa ni-pa-i-tou samding-in ta raroun ki næi.
S.TRANSL: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
父啊，我在哪裏，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裏，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。

S.FORM: Rama ka matiktik, assi ni-kmalang ymhou-an ta næi: râ ti jau ta ni-kmalang ymhou-an, ka ni-kmalang-appa ta neni k'atta ki ni-padingi-en hou jau-an.
S.TRANSL: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
公義的父啊，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pak'alang-en-nau neini-æn ta Nanang oho, ka pa-kalang-eil-appa-mau: alei ka ka-væ'angö-en k'anna ki ni-kavæ-'angö-en-hou jau-an i-tou-koua-âl-ato neini-æn, ti jau-appa nei-ni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裏面，我也在他們裏面。」
